_comment: Sample candidate moves built from the case appendix (Mounjaro/Zepbound lead obesity; Trulicity loses exclusivity in 2027; Trulicity and Verzenio enter the IRA 2028 cycle; rivals Ozempic, Wegovy, Wegovy pill). finding_ids are v3 ids in out/LLY/findings_v3.jsonl (gated rows only). Parameter values marked assumption are team inputs, not facts; they are flagged in decide.md.

moves.name: Expand the LillyDirect cash-pay Zepbound channel (MFN-aligned)
moves.why: LLY's MFN agreement puts Zepbound at an average $346 a month through TrumpRx; a larger self-pay channel at MFN-aligned prices protects share and reaches uninsured patients (case appendix).

share_moved.note: 10 points of volume to self-pay; precedent ~35% of new scripts (Walmart/LillyDirect 2025)

price_delta.note: self-pay net 20% below current net; no product-level net price is public

baseline_delta_rev_annual.note: s_MFN 0.0065 x 13,484 (spec 4.3 c): Medicaid MFN erosion of the baseline

moves.note: Re-pointed from LLY-labels-595152 (v3 d2aae6b94153, 'zepbound lists 2 indications vs rival median 5'). The recount from epi/indication_map.csv rows, each cited to its DailyMed label line, gives zepbound 2 vs wegovy 3, below the detector's 2-indication rule, so FIND drops that row. The move now rests on the passing MFN/TrumpRx finding ccde14de6e25 (Zepbound avg $346/mo cash price, White House fact sheet p. 1). Claim change: the move is argued from the cash-price channel, not from a narrower label.

moves.name: Defend Trulicity through the 2027 loss of exclusivity and switch patients to Mounjaro
moves.why: Trulicity's Medicare price is set by negotiation from January 2028 and its US compound patent ends in 2027 (FY2025 10-K patent table); a rebate-wall defense and a Mounjaro switch program value the retained revenue.

loe_month.note: January 2027, 10-K patent table (Trulicity compound patent U.S. 2027)

moves.note: Re-pointed from LLY-labels-746909 (v3 d8177d9f7349, now 68c1713e96ef: 'trulicity protection ends 2026-09-18, 14.4 years before ozempic'). Engine fix: the Trulicity date is now the company-stated 2027 cited to the FY2025 10-K page (pipeline/loe_calendar.csv row, facts.locator LLY:10k_FY2025.md#p12) and the gap is derived as rival year minus product year. The row still fails: ozempic's 2041-02-17 is an Orange Book table value with no verified facts row or page, so the 14-year gap has an unverified operand. The move now rests on the passing finding 4bf1a2f5e9e4 (Trulicity selected for IRA negotiation, price set from January 2028). Claim change: the Trulicity pressure is argued from the IRA 2028 price and the cited 2027 compound patent, not from a gap to ozempic.

moves.name: Seek new Zepbound indications to close the label gap with Wegovy
moves.why: Zepbound's label lists fewer indications than Wegovy's (cited label lines); outcomes trials would widen the addressable pool.

peak_sales.note: 8% of Zepbound US FY2025 revenue 13,484; team input pending the label-channel finding (4.3 h)

moves.note: Was tied to LLY-labels-595152. The cited recount (zepbound 2 indication rows vs wegovy 3) does not meet the detector's narrower-label rule, so no passing finding supports this move: it carries strategic fit 0 and is shown only as an alternative, never the recommendation (spec 5.2).
